description: Converts lengths on one device between its layout unit (pt on iOS, dp on Android) and physical pixels (px), at the device's measured scale or density. For dp to px on Android it also gives the whole pixel Compose's Dp.roundToPx() returns. Each value is between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000.

device.description: A device id from list_devices, such as iphone-17 or pixel-8.

name: convert_units

pixelsPerUnit.description: Physical pixels per pt or dp: the scale on iOS, the density divided by 160 on Android, unrounded.

title: Convert between pt, dp and px
